summary: Saudi-led coalition destroyed 50 Houthi military targets across Sanaa, Hodeidah, and Saada governorates in Yemen. Israeli Air Force struck four Hamas weapon depots across Gaza and targeted the son of Hamas leader Khalil al-Hayya in Gaza City's Rimal neighborhood, wounding six Palestinians. Israeli warplanes conducted strikes near Kfar Tibnit in southern Lebanon while artillery shelling hit Zoutar Al-Sharqiya and Mayfdon.

sections.threat_assessment: Simultaneous escalation across multiple fronts indicates heightened regional volatility. The Saudi-led coalition's 50-target strike in Yemen demonstrates sustained pressure on Houthi capabilities while Israeli operations intensify in Gaza with leadership decapitation attempts and expand into southern Lebanon with airstrikes near Nabatieh. Naval tensions in the Strait of Hormuz involving US enforcement of blockade measures against Iranian-linked shipping, combined with UAV activity over western Iran, suggest expanding maritime and aerial confrontation zones. The deployment of USS Makin Island ARG with 13th MEU to Indian Ocean reinforces US power projection capacity amid widening conflict geography.
sections.regional_response: Kuwait's official characterization of 'Iranian aggression' causing casualties requiring ministerial hospital visits signals GCC alignment with anti-Iran posture. Iraq's OPEC quota negotiations reflect Baghdad's economic maneuvering amid regional instability. The Saudi coalition's public claim of 50 destroyed Houthi targets serves deterrence messaging. Lebanese civil defense (DCA) conducting controlled explosions indicates ongoing unexploded ordnance management from previous conflicts. Palestinian Authority security coordination with Shin Bet on West Bank cell disruption reveals continued counterterrorism cooperation despite political tensions.
sections.intelligence_notes: FromIran's 120-second delayed reporting on Hormuz explosions and Sanandaj UAV sighting suggests operational security constraints on real-time Iranian airspace monitoring. CENTCOM's public acknowledgment of disabling M/V Pacific Archer confirms US naval blockade enforcement near Bandar Abbas. Live map channels (redlinkleb) tracking Israeli aircraft over Lebanon provide open-source intelligence on IAF sortie patterns. The 13th MEU deployment aboard Makin Island ARG positions crisis response forces within striking distance of Yemen, Somalia, and Persian Gulf contingencies. Hamas confirmation of al-Hayya's son survival indicates either precision strike limitations or deliberate non-lethal targeting.
